newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BOBIC SECURES FIRST WIN FOR STUTTGART.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOBIC SECURES FIRST WIN FOR STUTTGART.

text.p: International striker Fredi Bobic on Friday gave VfB Stuttgart their first league win of the season, scoring from close range to secure a 1-0 victory over Bayer Leverkusen.

Bobic put the German Cup holders ahead in the 18th minute and Stuttgart held on to take all three points despite having defender Thorsten Legat sent off early in the second half for persistent fouling.
Ruhr Valley rivals Bochum and Duisburg drew 0-0 in the evening's other Bundesliga game.
